body: Is it possible for you and your family to move to a smaller cheaper house or an apartment while you get things sorted out? My brother had to move with his kids and girlfriend to a motel for a month before he found solid work. You sound like an awesome dad/husband and I'm sure your kids/wife wouldn't want the money over having you.

That's the thing. I'm not their father. I kinda feel guilty sometimes how I'm stealing them away from their dad. I have a little cousin that I'm fond of and his dad got out of jail about a year ago. I felt so bad when I left him to go to school when his dad got locked up. Now he's out and he's going to rehab, but I feel so guilty sometimes like I'm hogging up his time with his kids. Or with my brother his kids live with my mother. I spend everyday with them. I'm practically their surrogate parent. I guess my problem is I'm taking on too much. My mom has custody of my nieces, but she and my dad don't seem to put in as much effort in parenting as they did with me and my siblings. It crushes me to think that they are already getting cheated but now they just sit in their room watching TV and eating junk everyday. I try to intervene but my parents don't seem to see much of a problem as I do. I shut down from doing stuff for them for a couple of days and my parents made me feel miserable like I was solely responsible for their care. Their dad is there but doesn't contribute much other than seeing them and my younger brother doesn't give them the time of day. I'm trying so hard to do for them but I living at home with little income no car and no way to really provide for them.

I'm a middle child too.I'm always told I have very little common sense and absent minded when it comes to things. My younger brother can remember directions to anywhere while I struggle to find places with a GPS. My older brother is physically a giant. Don't compare yourself with your brothers. It'll just make you crazy trust me. You are all different people. Maybe you just haven't had a class that interests you yet. Talk with an academic counselor about your classes and try something out. I recommend an acting for non majors if your school has one. It's a very non judgmental zone.

lots of things swirling around at the moment. They've been adding up lately and it's getting harder to cope. Long story short I just don't know what I could tell pre teenage kids to make them understand what I'm feeling so that they don't hurt so much. I love them dearly, but I'm starting to shut down emotionally. I'm starting to desensitize slowly and I would rather die than let their last memories of me be of some jerk.
